stratum-ai-news.description: Researches the latest AI industry news (past 2 weeks), synthesizes a dark-mode newspaper-style HTML report, and publishes it as a new or updated edition to Cloudflare Pages at ainews.edstratumlabs.ai.
stratum-ai-news.name: Stratum AI News — Research, Synthesize & Publish

discord-bot-designer.description: Design, build, deploy, and manage Discord bots on Schubert — create new bots, modify existing ones, update personalities, guardrails, and tools.
discord-bot-designer.name: Discord Bot Designer
discord-bot-designer.pre_trigger_question:
Discord Bot Designer is ready! What would you like to do?

Examples:
- Create a new bot called <name> that <purpose>
- Modify <bot name> to <change>
- Update personality of <bot name> to <description>
- Update guardrails on <bot name> to <description>
- Add a tool to <bot name> that <description>
- Debug <bot name> with symptoms <description>
